name: niteshift
title: Niteshift
description: Run, monitor, and prompt Niteshift background agents from Raycast.
author: joshlebed

preferences.name: environment
preferences.title: Environment
preferences.description: Which Niteshift environment the extension talks to. Must match the environment you authed against with `niteshift auth`.

commands.name: run-task
commands.title: Run Task
commands.description: Create a new Niteshift task using your default repo and model. Type the prompt as the argument.

commands.name: list-tasks
commands.title: List Tasks
commands.description: Browse recent Niteshift tasks. Watch a stream, send a follow-up prompt, or copy a pickup command from the action menu (⌘K).
